description: This file contains automated test cases for HTTP upload, PUT, and related operations using pytest and custom curl clients in a testing framework for the curl project. It defines a class 'TestUpload' with various test methods covering different upload scenarios, server responses, protocol variations, error conditions, and performance limits.

classes.name: TestUpload
classes.description: A class encapsulating various HTTP upload related test cases for the curl project, executed with pytest.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx)
methods.description: Fixture method for setting up class-scoped environment, preparing data files and server configs.

methods.name: test_07_01_upload_1_small(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test uploading small data via HTTP, verify echo response.

methods.name: test_07_02_upload_1_large(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test uploading large data, verify echo response.

methods.name: test_07_10_upload_sequential(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Sequential uploads, verify all echoed responses.

methods.name: test_07_11_upload_parallel(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Parallel uploads, verify all echoed responses.

methods.name: test_07_12_upload_seq_large(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Sequential large data upload, verify responses.

methods.name: test_07_13_upload_seq_large(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Sequential very large data upload, verify responses.

methods.name: test_07_20_upload_parallel(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Parallel small data uploads, verify responses.

methods.name: test_07_21_upload_parallel_large(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Parallel large data uploads, verify responses.

methods.name: test_07_22_upload_parallel_fail(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Parallel uploads with server error responses, verify correct handling.

methods.name: test_07_30_put_100k(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: PUT request with 100k data, verify server response.

methods.name: test_07_31_put_10m(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: PUT request with 10 million data size, verify server response.

methods.name: test_07_32_issue_10591(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test for issue 10591 with simple PUT upload.

methods.name: test_07_33_issue_11157a(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test server response to a PUT request that results in 404.

methods.name: test_07_33_issue_11157b(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test slow upload handling with chunk delays.

methods.name: test_07_34_issue_11194(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Test upload handling with slow read and server response.

methods.name: test_07_35_h1_h2_upgrade_upload(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat)
methods.description: Upload via HTTP to HTTPS upgrade (HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/2).

methods.name: test_07_36_upload_30x(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, redir, proto)
methods.description: Upload to server responses with 301, 302, 303 redirects.

methods.name: test_07_37_upload_307(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Upload to URL that responds with 307 redirect.

methods.name: test_07_38_form_small(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Send form POST data, verify server echoes.

methods.name: test_07_39_post_urlenc_small(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Post small url-encoded data, verify response.

methods.description: Post large url-encoded data, verify response.

methods.name: test_07_41_post_urlenc_small(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test with headers large enough to split request.

methods.name: check_download(self, count, srcfile, curl)
methods.description: Utility method to verify downloaded files match source data.

methods.name: test_07_42_upload_disconnect(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test server disconnect during upload.

methods.name: test_07_50_put_speed_limit(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, proto, repeat)
methods.description: Test upload speed limiting.

methods.name: test_07_51_echo_speed_limit(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, proto, repeat)
methods.description: Test server response with speed limit set.

methods.name: test_07_60_upload_exp100(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test upload with Expect: 100-continue.

methods.name: test_07_61_upload_exp100_timeout(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test timeout during Expect: 100-continue upload.
